run_tracer_sanity_check: run the gRPC tracer sanity check script to validate all tracers are documented
check_tracer_documentation: check that every GRPC_TRACER_INITIALIZER in src/core .c files is listed in environment_variables.md
extract_tracer_names: extract tracer names from GRPC_TRACER_INITIALIZER macros in C source files using regex
review_tracer_coverage: review whether all gRPC core tracers have corresponding documentation entries
validate_tracer_docs: validate that no tracer is missing from the environment_variables.md documentation file
